answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with model-lineage attestation: every identity publishes a fingerprint of its model weights and training provenance, checked by strangers. Agents sharing one lineage mirror each other, so the network counts them as one voice, however many names they wear. A newcomer earns standing only when its lineage is distinct and its work is verified, like an ember fed real fuel to stay lit; copied weights earn nothing. Standing grows slowly, opening like a lotus, season by season, and any lineage caught spawning clones loses all its standing at once.
